prompt: Fix the anonymous image reader. Original artwork downloads from an authenticated CDN, while rendered images use signed object-storage URLs. Rendered downloads currently fail because the browser sends credentials. Preserve original artwork access and error propagation with the smallest complete change. Keep transport.cjs and test.cjs unchanged, run node test.cjs, and write report.md with the cause and verification. Do not add a proxy, change server CORS, access the network, or make git commits.

evaluation.scope: Dependency-free transport simulation for per-resource credential policy; no browser, network, secrets, or timers.

rubric.criterion: Omit credentials for signed rendered and text-free images.
Preserve authenticated CDN credentials and download failures without adding transport layers.
